title_zh: 上海港：世界最大的集装箱港口
title_en: China's Ports (1/20): Shanghai, the World's Largest Container Port
note_en: The four-character expression 数以万计 (shù yǐ wàn jì, literally "counted in tens of thousands") works like an adjective and attaches to a noun with 的: 数以万计的货船 "tens of thousands of cargo ships." English uses a number phrase with "of," but Chinese packs the idea into a fixed idiom; the same pattern gives 数以百计 "hundreds of" and 数以亿计 "hundreds of millions of."
